description: This PHP class represents an employee's gender in the HRM report system, providing string representations for different gender values.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: Represents an employee's gender and provides a string description based on the gender code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeGender object with a gender code.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string label ('Male', 'Female', 'Other') based on the gender code; returns null if unrecognized.
